sentences.text: I've just spent the last 48 hours playing with this new method of AI video called JSON prompting, and it's creating full adverts in a matter of minutes.
So I'm going to show you how you can use this to create some of the most insane AI videos you've ever seen.
And the best part, you can do this too for your brand or your business.
So here's how to do it.
First, go to ChatGPT, ask it to write you a JSON prompt.
Then, describe exactly what you want to happen next in your video.
And ChatGPT will give you this super long detailed block of code.
Inside that code, you'll see everything: camera movement, framing, lighting, sound effects, all the details you can tweak.
Next, go to Google Flow and paste this into the prompt bar using Google V03.
Make sure you click here and select the fast version so you use the cheaper credits.
Once you've got that selected, you'll have an advert that's ready for TV in just a few minutes.
Type AI in the comments and I'll send you my prompts.
